retrieved_context: In practice, we compute the attention function on a set of queries simultaneously, packed together into a matrix Q. The keys and values are also packed together into matrices K and V . We compute the matrix of outputs as: QKT √dk Attention(Q,K,V ) = softmax( )V (1) The two most commonly used attention functions are additive attention [2], and dot-product (multiplicative) attention. Dot-product attention is identical to our algorithm, except for the scaling factor of √1d . Additive attention computes the compatibility function using a feed-forward network with a single hidden layer. While the two are similar in theoretical complexity, dot-product attention is much faster and more space-efficient in practice, since it can be implemented using highly optimized matrix multiplication code.

llm_answer: Debt Mutual Funds (MFs) generally offer higher liquidity compared to Bank Fixed Deposits (FDs). Bank FDs often have a lock-in period and may incur penalties for premature withdrawal, whereas Debt MFs allow for more flexible withdrawals without such penalties. However, the liquidity of Debt MFs can depend on the specific fund and its redemption policies. Bank FDs provide guaranteed returns with no market risk, while Debt MFs offer potential for higher returns but are subject to market risks.
